scope: Retrospective conditional sampled OLX benchmark; no new holdout or model training
hypothesis: Risk-dependent within-query standardization attenuates transferable differences between personalized and control risk scores.
raw_auxiliary: a(r,i)=log1p(S_i)-r*log1p(N_i), with pathway-specific, training-only mature attempt counts
reference_risk: The existing fixed-global conditional risk r0, unchanged from the prior experiment. The same query-specific reference denominator is used for every risk variant, including success-only. It uses candidate features, never target relevance.
primary_representation: Previously calibrated conditional probabilities; zero denotes success-only
selection: Each normalization and risk variant receives the same full validation cohort and grid; maximize NDCG@10, then Recall@10, then prefer smaller gamma. Serialize settings before test scoring.
fixed_weight_purpose: Isolate normalization changes without retuning the fusion weight.
ranking: Exact descending score with ascending item ID for ties; same 1000 distinct eligible candidates and target identities as the corrected protocol.
primary_endpoint: Per-query NDCG@10; one case per test user

uncertainty.method: Paired user bootstrap with shared resamples
uncertainty.primary_intervals: Pointwise 95% and Bonferroni 99.1666667% percentile intervals for the six planned contrasts; approximately 95% family coverage.
uncertainty.secondary: RP3Beta, P3LTR component, and fixed-weight contrasts receive exploratory pointwise 95% intervals only.
uncertainty.interpretation: All inference remains exploratory because these test cases were inspected before this experiment.

secondary_metrics: Recall@10 (identical to HitRate@10 for one target)
Tail exposure using training event-count quartiles
coverage_caution: Coverage is over top-ten lists from sampled candidates, not full-catalog recommendations or verified available vacancies.
integrity: Verify input hashes and calibrated-score eligibility.
Reconstruct RP3Beta scores once and cache them in float64.
Exactly reproduce saved current-normalization development selection and test target ranks.
Fixed-global scores must be identical under both normalizations.
Check exact sorting against an independent rank oracle and test tie handling.
Do not adapt the normalization, grid, controls, or hypothesis after examining new test results.
Retain every control and both normalizations regardless of outcome.
Do not infer candidate-specific nonprogression probability from a source-attempt score.
decision: A larger score difference alone is not a useful ranking improvement. Interpret actual risk against matched controls and stronger simple baselines; do not claim an accuracy advance solely from beating RP3Beta.
